fin3403-exam4-leverage-02-leverage-chain.title: How Leverage Links the Income Statement
fin3403-exam4-leverage-02-leverage-chain.caption: Operating leverage carries a change in sales into operating income; financial leverage carries a change in operating income into earnings per share.

fin3403-exam4-leverage-06-triangle-diagr.title: The Three Measures of Leverage
fin3403-exam4-leverage-06-triangle-diagr.caption: DOL links sales to operating income, DFL links operating income to earnings per share, and DCL spans the whole chain from sales to earnings per share.

fin3403-exam4-leverage-07-dol-chain-diag.title: Degree of Operating Leverage
steps: Sales, operating income and earnings per share are linked by the two kinds of leverage.
With a degree of operating leverage of 2, operating income rises by twice as much: 20%.

fin3403-exam4-leverage-08-dfl-chain-diag.title: Degree of Financial Leverage
steps: The same chain, read from operating income to earnings per share.
With a degree of financial leverage of 3, earnings per share fall three times as far: 30%.

fin3403-exam4-leverage-09-dcl-chain-diag.title: Degree of Combined Leverage
steps: Combined leverage runs the whole chain, from sales to earnings per share.
With a degree of combined leverage of 4, earnings per share rise four times as far: 40%.
